operator_direction: Do not spend routine research budget on Gemma or GPT-OSS. Use them only when an explicit comparator/parity question justifies the call.
research_team_role: invent algorithms, prompts, representations and experiments; do not substitute itself for target-model benchmark execution
public_eval_policy: milestone-only sealed evaluation; never use repeated public-eval feedback to tune the solver
score_metric: exact task accuracy with up to two predicted outputs per test input
